description: This file contains a comprehensive set of test cases for Git merge behavior, focusing on complex scenarios involving renames, adds, deletes, conflicts, and binary files. It sets up various git repositories with specific commit patterns and tests the merge outcomes, including conflict detection, content merging, and index/state verification.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_delete_untracked
methods.description: Sets up a repository to test handling of rename and delete operations with untracked files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Executes a test case expecting successful completion, verifying specific behaviors.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Executes a test case expecting failure, often used to ensure certain conflicts or errors are correctly handled.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_modify_add_source
methods.description: Prepares a repository for testing merging scenarios involving sources of renames and modifications.

methods.name: test_conflicts_with_adds_and_renames
methods.description: Function that runs multiple sub-tests to verify conflict detection when adding and renaming files.

methods.name: test_setup_collision_conflict
methods.description: Creates specific scenarios of file conflicts, renames, and content merges to test conflict resolution.

methods.name: test_conflicts_with_adds_and_renames
methods.description: Tests complex cases where files are added and renamed simultaneously, verifying conflict detection and merge correctness.

methods.name: test_setup_nested_conflicts_from_rename_rename
methods.description: Sets up a nested conflict scenario involving multiple renames and modifications across branches.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Checks that merge conflicts are correctly identified in nested rename scenarios.

methods.name: test_setup_mod6
methods.description: Prepares test data involving chains of renames to verify conflicts in complex rename chains.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Verifies that conflicting rename chains produce expected conflict messages and the index reflects the merge state.
